{"code":"def transform(grid):
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=0]
    if not pts: return out
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts)
    c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
    # 3x3 marker, rays point outward from its center
    rm=(r0+r1)//2; cm=(c0+c1)//2
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
      for c in range(c0,c1+1):
        v=grid[r][c]
        if not v: continue
        dr = -1 if r<rm else (1 if r>rm else 0)
        dc = -1 if c<cm else (1 if c>cm else 0)
        rr=r+dr; cc=c+dc
        while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w:
          if out[rr][cc]==0: out[rr][cc]=v
          rr+=dr; cc+=dc
    return out"}

{"code":"def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    cells=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v]
    r0=min(r for r,c in cells); r1=max(r for r,c in cells)
    c0=min(c for r,c in cells); c1=max(c for r,c in cells)
    # assumed 3x3 colored tile
    rm=(r0+r1)//2; cm=(c0+c1)//2
    H=len(grid); W=len(grid[0])
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
      for c in range(c0,c1+1):
        v=grid[r][c]
        if not v: continue
        if r==r0: dr,dc=-1,c-cm
        elif r==r1: dr,dc=1,c-cm
        elif c==c0: dr,dc=0,-1
        elif c==c1: dr,dc=0,1
        else: continue
        rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
        while 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W:
          out[rr][cc]=v
          rr+=dr; cc+=dc
    return out"}

        dc= -1 if c<cm else (1 if c>cm else 0)
        if dr==0 and dc==0: continue
        rr=r+dr; cc=c+dc
        while 0<=rr<R and 0<=cc<C:
            out[rr][cc]=grid[r][c]
